text: הֶחֱרַט בַּסֵּֽפֶר. לְבִלְתִּי מְצוֹא כֹּֽפֶר. קִיּוּם זִכְרוֹן זֶה סֵֽפֶר. לְפָנָיו יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר צָפוּן מֹרְדֵי אוֹר. תָּמִים דּוֹר כָּאוֹר. צִיָּה כְּחָר לָאוֹר. קְנוּיָו יִזְכֹּר: צְפוּפִים פְּנֵי נָאוֹר. מִשְׁפָּטָם תֵּת לָאוֹר. צַחַן רוֹעַ שְׂאוֹר. בְּרִיב בַּל יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר פְּעֻלַּת אֶזְרָח. הֵעַרְתָּהּ מִמִּזְרָח. פָּעֳלוֹ יִזְרָח. בְּקֶֽרֶב שָׁנִים יִזְכֹּר: פַּח אִם הָטְרַח. פִּרְחָיו לְמָרַח. פִּלּוּלוֹ יִצְרַח. בַּעֲדָם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר עֲקֵדַת מוֹרִיָּה. כְּהִיַּת רְאִיָּה. עֲדֵי עֵרוֹם וְעֶרְיָה. סְבוּכוֹ יִזְכּוֹר: עֵֽצֶב טְרִיָּה. אִם כּוֹאֲבָה פּוֹרִיָּה. עֲתָרוֹ לִרְאִיָּה. וְלִזְכוּת יִזְכֹּר: זֵֽכֶר סֻלָּם חָלָם. וְעָלָיו מְחוֹלְלָם. שָׂרֵי אַרְבַּע וְעֻלָּם. בּוֹ כְּמֵאָז יִזְכֹּר: שְׂרִיגָיו בְּמַעֲלָם. וַיֹּאמַר לְגָעֳלָם. שִׂיחוֹ

חֵמָה. וְיוּחַק לַדּוֹרֹת. שְׁמוֹ לְזִכָּרוֹן: וּמִי שׂוֹנֵא בֶֽצַע. יְדַבֵּר עֲנוּ בִי. וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר עֵד. אָדוֹן לְזִכָּרוֹן: וּבְטָלֵה חָלָב. יְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדֵנוּ. וּכְנֶֽגֶד שְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. יַעַל לְזִכָּרוֹן: זַֽעַף יֵרָא וַיֹּאמַר. תְּהִי יָדְךָ בִי. אֲשֶׁר כְּלֵב אֱלֹהָיו. הוּא לְזִכָּרוֹן: זָעַק וְהֵשִׁיב. חֶֽרֶב אֶל נְדָנָהּ. וְהוּשַׁת לוֹ כַּשֶּֽׁמֶשׁ. כֵּס לְזִכָּרוֹן: חִכֵּתִי בְּעֵת עֶצֶר. לְפוֹתֵחַ וּמַמְטִיר. כְּמֵשִׁיב רוּחַ לַיֶּֽלֶד. אָבוּד מִזִּכָּרוֹן: חַי לִרְאוֹת בְּרִית. בְּדַבְּרוֹ קִנֵּאתִי. כִּי עָזְבוּ עָם. בְּרִית וְזִכָּרוֹן: טֶֽרֶם הָיָה לִי. מְכַפֵּר פָּנִים. מִנְחָה הֹלֶֽכֶת. כַּשֹּׁחַד לְזִכָּרוֹן: טֶֽרֶף נֵרְדְּ וְסַמִּים. לְמֵסַב חֲדָרָיו. דָּם וָחֵֽלֶב לְנִיחֹחַ. וְלֶֽחֶם הַפָּנִים לְזִכָּרוֹן: יֻצַּֽגְתִּי עַל גֶּחָלֵי רֵיקָה. כִּי לֹא אַלְמָן. שַׁתִּי לְזִכָּרוֹן: יָהּ אֶבְטַח בָּךְ. וְלֹא

He remembers the hidden one (Noah) in the age of open rebels, the perfect and the pure; when He is angry and wishes to curse the earth, He remembers those acquired by Him (Israel). As to those who stand crowded together before the countenance of the Awe-inspiring, may He bring to light their judgment; may He not in strife recall the ugly evil leaven. He remembers the work of that strong one whom He told to rise up from the east (Abraham). May He soon recall his shining act. When destruction threatens to annihilate his offspring, may his supplication become audible that He may remember them kindly. He remembers the sacrifice on Moriah (Isaac) whose eyes become dim; for the sake of people naked and bare, may He recall the ram caught in the thicket. When the fruitful people is afflicted with a festering wound, may his prayer be manifest that God may remember his merit. He remembers him who saw the ladder in the dream (Jacob); above it the Creator appeared to him, showed him the princes of the four empires and their yoke. He will remember him, as in former days. back anger (like Pinhas),then let his name be inscribed for future generations as a remembrance. Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance. With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance. When he saw the wrath of the Lord, he (David) said: “Let Thy hand turn against me”, that he conformed to the will of his God is his remembrance. He cried out and caused the angel’s sword to return to its sheath, therefore was his throne established as firmly as the sun for remembrance. At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance. He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance. Formerly I had one who could atone before the Lord, when he brought the meal-offering as a bribe for remembrance. Gifts of nard and spices perfumed His chambers, blood and fat as a delight and the show-bread for remembrance.
